parsed.explanation: Elevated risk on thin, mostly structural evidence. Negatives: a trans-specific public-presentation offence (male soliciting 'with intent to deceive as to true sex') sits on the books with no recorded enforcement, so it is a dormant lever rather than documented practice. Visitor documents carry birth-sex markers with no matching route, a known exposure at checkpoints though border practice is unsourced. No SOGI anti-discrimination law covers services, so a visitor refused service has no statutory recourse. Rising hostility toward gender-nonconforming people is documented as a climate, and a 2021 activist murder is a single case, not a pattern. Positives: an indigenous feminine third-gender tradition is documented as traditionally supportive, though threatened, and the sodomy statute is unenforced in the record and tangential. Hate-crime recourse and police response are unknown, so I resolve toward the structural risk.
